title: Service pistol
paint:
A polymer-frame striker-fired service pistol, the pistol in every holster. Pose: side profile turned slightly toward the viewer, muzzle right, level, filling about 80% of the canvas width. Silhouette, kept exactly: a blocky, squared steel slide with a flat top, squared front and fine vertical serrations at the rear; a small open ejection port; a polymer frame with a squared trigger guard; a trigger with a small safety blade in its face; no hammer showing; a slightly angled grip with shallow finger grooves and a flush magazine base. Materials: matte black slide with edges rubbed grey, black polymer frame. Maker's touch: one faded blue-grey (#5394AC) grip panel set into the side of the grip.
At 32 px: a plain blocky slide on a squared frame, no hammer.
